records.subject: Demand to set up Ahir Regiment in Indian Army.
records.SM_Text:
Shri Anil Kumar Yadav Mandadi: The brave men and women of the country dedicated themselves to protect the nation as and when it faces danger. Ahir Community is one such community who fought with valour and bravery whenever the situation demanded. Ahir?s contribution in protecting the motherland and fighting war against invaders can be gauged from events of resisting invasion by Nadir Shah and Taimur, participation in the 1857 revolt against British Empire, struggle for independence, Indo-China War, Kargil War etc., Notably, in the Battle of Rexang La during the 1962 war with China, many troops consisting Ahir (Yadav) community predominantly fought with valour and courage in order to protect the honour and dignity of our country. There is a sizeable number of people belonging to Ahir community in the Indian Army. As on date, there are 18 regiments in the Indian Army. Out of these 18 many regiments were named after various communities as well as States.? The regiments named after communities are Jat Regiment, Gorkha Riffles, Sikh Regiment, Dogra Regiment, Garhwal Regiment, Kumaon Regiment. Considering their valuable contribution to the Indian Army and services to the nation, the Ahir community is time and again requesting to raise Ahir regiment may be formed in the Indian Army. Therefore, I request the Government to raise Ahir Regiment in the Indian Army.?

(ENDS)

 

?????????

records.subject: Demand to confer Bharat Ratna award to Mahatma Jyotiba Phule and Savitribai Phule
records.SM_Text:
Shri Anil Kumar Yadav Mandadi: ??????????? Mahatma Jyotiba Phule was an activist thinker, social reformer and revolutionary from Maharashtra in the 19th century.? He believed that equality and oneness is necessary for the development of the country. In 1873, he and his colleagues founded Satyashodhak Samaj which propagated that all human beings are equal. Mahatma Phule believed that education empowers the low caste people and brings them to mainstream life. ?In 1882, he had pleaded for compulsory primary education to all before the Hunter Commission. Taking cue from the ideas of Phule, many social reformers including Babasaheb Ambedkar emphasized on educating weaker sections of the society which in turn led to the slogan ?Educate, Organize and Agitate?.? Sensing the importance of women education, Mahatma Phule encouraged his wife Savitri Bhai Phule to educate women of the society particularly weaker section. In 1848, Jyotiba Phule and Savitribai Phule started indigenous girls school in Pune. The couples tirelessly fought for the women upliftment, widow marriage, women education etc.? Because of their tireless efforts, the 19th & 20th century has seen women excelling in fields such as agriculture, education, knowledge, science, research, space, politics and social service, actively contributing to the nations progress. After independence, the social reformers, freedom fighters, men and women from various walks of life were honored with higher civilian award.? I urge the Government to confer Bharat Ratna Award to the social reformer couple Mahatma Jyotiba Phule and Savitribai Phule for their effective contribution for upliftment of girls education and social reforms like widow marriage.

(ENDS)

records.subject: Demand to withdraw the decision to disinvest Vizag Steel Plant.
records.SM_Text:
Shri Anil Kumar Yadav Mandadi: Cabinet Committee of Economic Affairs (CCEA) in 2021 accorded ?in-principle? approval for 100% disinvestment of Government of India (GOI) share-holding in RashtriyaIspat Nigam Limited (RINL) also known as Vizag Steel Plant.

The people of erstwhile united Andhra Pradesh had demanded the Steel Plant by raising slogans ?VizagaEkku, AndhraluHakku?. Giving due respect to the people?s sentiments, the then PM laid foundation stone for this Steel Plant in 1977. The plant was commissioned in year 1992. 64 villages sacrificed their land which is about 22,000 acres. More than 16,000 people got displaced in order to build this plant. Therefore, the decision to disinvest is not in the interest of people and steel plant. There is no own captive mines for Vizag Steel Plant. In order to run its plant at its full strength, it has to import iron ore at higher cost. Instead of opting for privatization, the Government must take efforts to supply required raw material to Vizag Steel Plant including supply of Iron ore through National Mineral Development Corporation. The people are agitated by the decision of the Government to disinvest Vizag steel Plant. Workers of Vizag Steel Plant, people from various fields are agitating against the Centre?s decision on Vizag Steel Plant. Padayatra was also organised in this regard. Considering the sentiments expressed by the people, I urge the Government to withdraw its decision to disinvest Vizag Steel Plant.

(ENDS)

records.subject: CONCERN OVER DRUG MENACE IN THE COUNTRY
records.SM_Text:
Shri Anil Kumar Yadav Mandadi: Recently, there were instances of seizure of huge haul of narcotic drugs in the country. In February, 2024 NCB has seized 3,300 kg drugs off Gujarat Coast. In March, 2024 there was a huge haul of narcotic drugs from Visakhapatnam Port. The use of Charas, Ganja, heroine, opium, brown sugar and other narcotic drug by youngsters in the country has increased manifold.?? States with International Borders are easily prone to illegal drug trade. Punjab, North Eastern States with International Border and coastal states are main drug trading centres. To some extent the State of Telangana is also seriously affected due to drug use. Drug abuse leads to serious health issues ? Heart disease, Lungs Disease, Cancer, AIDS, Hepatitis etc., The serious issue of drug abuse is to be handled seriously. There is a need for strategic change in policing the drug abuse. Instead of focusing on ?Drug abuse?, Government has to focus on ?Drug Trade? and take effective measures to prevent the smuggling/illegal trafficking of drugs into the country. Therefore, I urge the Government to take stern and stringent action against the drug traders so that the drugs do not enter the country.

(Ends)

records.subject: Roof collapse at Delhi Airport T1
records.extent:
This Ministry has constituted a High Level Expert Committee consisting of
Structural Engineers from IIT Delhi to assess the incident at Delhi T1 and submit
its report. All the Airport Operators, including those at Telangana, have been
directed to carry out a Third Party Audit of structural stability of Airport buildings
and associated infrastructures through a reputed Government Institution/ Body
such as IITs, NITs, CBRI, EIL etc. Further, all the Airport Operators have also
been directed to carry out a thorough evaluation of all civil, electrical and technical
aspects of the building including the design, specifications and workmanship of the
roof sheeting structure before the onset of monsoon every year.
